solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Matter of imaginary circle being reduced in radius

indicators.note: a word reduced in something loses that thing, so a letter is taken out

parts.note: the tropics are imaginary circles of latitude round the globe

explanation.surface: A geometry query about a circle whose radius is being shrunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced in' takes R out of TROPIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is the subject or matter under discussion.

clue.text: International police force feeds suffering race

indicators.note: feeds means goes into, so these letters are put inside

parts.note: a trial is an ordeal or suffering
the Met is London's Metropolitan Police

explanation.surface: An international police force supplies a painful race.
explanation.walkthrough: THE MET is the Metropolitan Police, London's police force.
explanation.definitionFit: A time trial is a race where competitors are timed individually against the clock.

clue.text: Go mad over eating a dish from Asia

indicators.note: eating takes the next piece inside
over in a down clue turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: to flip is to go mad

explanation.surface: Losing it while eating an Asian meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' reverses FLIP to PILF; 'eating' puts A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilaf is a rice dish of Middle Eastern and South Asian cooking.

clue.text: At first, Barry Cryer sick, consuming old whiskey and fruit

indicators.note: consuming takes the following letters inside
sick indicates the letters are disordered and rearranged
at first takes only the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: Whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Comedian Barry Cryer is ill after drinking old whiskey and eating fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: Barry Cryer was a British comedy writer and performer. 'sick' rearranges B and CRYER to CBERRY; 'consuming' puts OW inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The cowberry is the lingonberry, a red fruit of a low shrub.

clue.text: Form of libertarianism, not stern, working wonders

indicators.note: a new form of a word is its letters rearranged into another order
not marks letters that must be taken away from the fodder before rearranging

explanation.surface: A version of libertarian politics without the hardline edge is producing miracles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' tells you some letters leave before the rearranging that 'Form of' signals; 'working' is only a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Mirabilia is a Latin plural for marvels or miraculous things, wonders.

clue.text: Spoils heavenly body

definitions.meaning: ... as a verb means spoils or blemishes

explanation.surface: A planet ruins things.
explanation.definitionFit: Mars is both the fourth planet and a verb meaning damages or blights.

clue.text: Beaky woman's boring mechanical performance

indicators.note: boring means drilling into, so this piece goes inside

parts.note: rote is mechanical repetition
Stella is a woman's name; the 's stands for is

explanation.surface: A beaky woman is tediously reciting by heart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boring' looks like dull; it means drilling into ROTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Rostellate is a botanical term meaning having a small beak, beaked.

clue.text: This was controlled by Christian generosity

definitions.meaning: HMS ..., seized by Fletcher Christian in the famous mutiny

explanation.surface: A Christian's control described as generosity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Christian' hints at religion; it is Fletcher Christian, who led the mutiny on the Bounty.
explanation.definitionFit: Bounty means munificence, generous giving, and names the ship Christian took over.

clue.text: Lungs initially heave in pain, a warning in the main

parts.note: lights are animal lungs as butcher's meat

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Breathing heavily in pain as a warning is issued at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A lightship is a moored vessel bearing a light that warns shipping at sea.

clue.text: Concerning beam, top should be cut

indicators.note: in a down answer the top is the first letter, which is to be removed

parts.note: a rafter is a sloping roof beam

explanation.surface: Advice about a roof beam: its top must be trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: After can mean about or concerning, as in asking after someone.

clue.text: Extract sulphur, found at last in most inferior plants

parts.note: to milk is to extract or draw off

indicators.note: the letter is relocated so it is found at the very end of the word

parts.note: worst means most inferior
S is the chemical symbol for sulphur

explanation.surface: Instructions to draw sulphur out of the poorest-quality plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found at last in' moves the S of WORST to the end, giving WORTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Milkworts are small flowering herbs, a genus of wild plants.

clue.text: Disown chain of Samsung, etc.

indicators.note: a chain of letters running across the words, here a string of consecutive letters lifted out

explanation.surface: Turning one's back on the chain of Samsung stores and similar outlets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chain of' picks the run across samsUNG ETc.
explanation.definitionFit: To unget is an archaic verb meaning to repudiate or deny parentage, to disown.

clue.text: Peg eating mouldy sweet

indicators.note: one word eating another takes it inside itself

parts.note: a tee is the peg a golf ball sits on
food gone off is mouldy

explanation.surface: Someone named Peg tucking into a sweet that has gone mouldy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Peg' looks like a woman's name; it is the golf TEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Toffee is a chewy confection, a kind of sweet or candy.

clue.text: One who leaves in a couple of ways?

definitions.text: One who leaves in a couple of ways?

parts.words: One who leaves in a couple of ways?
parts.note: the maker of a will leaves property to heirs and, by dying, also leaves this life

explanation.surface: A riddle about someone departing by two routes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' first reads as departing; the person also leaves bequests in a will.
explanation.definitionFit: A testator makes a will, bequeathing estate and departing this world.

clue.text: Ill-tempered raving idiot — primarily, he's bonkers

indicators.note: bonkers means crazy, so the letters are rearranged
primarily takes the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A grumpy raving fool who is, above all, mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raving' looks like the anagram signal but is fodder; 'bonkers' rearranges RAVING, I and HES.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinegarish means sour and acid in temper, bad-tempered.

clue.text: Legally inseparable member stops Blairite buckling

indicators.note: a piece that stops a gap in another word plugs into it
something buckling is bent out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A Labour MP blocks a Blair loyalist who is caving in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'member' suggests a limb or club member; here it is a Member of Parliament, and the buckling Blairite is the rearranged fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: In law an impartible estate cannot be divided among heirs.

clue.text: Clause in favour of imaginative future plan

parts.note: pro means in favour of
a vision is an imaginative plan for the future

explanation.surface: A contract clause supporting a far-sighted scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A provision is a stipulation or clause in a legal document.

clue.text: Hit husband in mouth, recoiling

indicators.note: recoiling springs back, so the whole is read in reverse
in places one letter inside another word

parts.note: a maw is an animal's mouth or jaws
H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogy and records

explanation.surface: A domestic blow: punching one's husband in the mouth, who reels back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' gives MAHW, which 'recoiling' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: Wham is a forceful strike, an onomatopoeic word for a blow.

clue.text: In which bread might be kept by breadbasket?

definitions.text: In which bread might be kept by breadbasket?

parts.words: In which bread might be kept by breadbasket?
parts.note: bread is slang for cash, and breadbasket is slang for the stomach, beside which this is worn

explanation.surface: A kitchen question about where to store a loaf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bread' is slang for money; 'breadbasket' is slang for the stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: A money belt is worn round the waist to hold cash safely.

clue.text: Dress code, of a sort — a warning, of course

parts.note: a PIN is a personal identification number, a sort of code
fore is the warning shouted on a golf course

explanation.surface: A kind of dress code is a sensible precaution, naturally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of course' reads as naturally but places the warning on a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinafore is a sleeveless dress worn over a blouse.

clue.text: A sign of unsocial backing, oddly so

indicators.note: backing means moving back, so the word is read from end to start
oddly picks the letters in the odd-numbered positions

explanation.surface: A symptom of antisocial retreat, and a strange one at that.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reads the word from its end, and 'oddly' then takes every other letter starting with the first; 'so' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Leo, symbolised by the lion, is a sign of the zodiac.

clue.text: Writer unexpectedly left pent-up after mistyping one adjacent key?

indicators.note: letters arriving unexpectedly come in an unforeseen order, so they are rearranged
on a keyboard the keys for U and I sit side by side, so one letter is replaced by its neighbour

explanation.surface: A typist left frustrated after a slip of the finger hits the neighbouring key.
explanation.walkthrough: On a QWERTY keyboard U and I are neighbours, so the mistyping swaps one for the other before 'unexpectedly' shuffles everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A felt-tip pen is a writing implement, so a writer in the object sense.

clue.text: Nearly select most of delicate piece of cake

indicators.note: nearly means not quite all, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: to pick is to select

indicators.note: most of drops the last letter

parts.note: nice can mean delicate or subtle, as in a nice distinction

explanation.surface: Choosing nearly all of a dainty slice of cake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'piece of cake' looks literal but means something easy.
explanation.definitionFit: A picnic, like a piece of cake, is something easy, as in 'no picnic'.

clue.text: Shocking state briefly engulfing most of Italian city

indicators.note: one piece engulfing another swallows it whole

parts.note: Cal is a short form of California, a US state

indicators.note: most of a word drops its final letter

parts.note: Rimini is a resort city on Italy's Adriatic coast

explanation.surface: An outrageous state of affairs has overwhelmed a large part of an Italian city.
explanation.walkthrough: Cal is an informal short form for California; Rimini is an Adriatic resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Criminal can mean scandalous or deplorable, as in 'a criminal waste'.

clue.text: Firm proclaims power without energy

indicators.note: without means lacking, so a letter is removed

parts.note: cries means proclaims or announces aloud in public
E is the physics symbol for energy
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: A company announces it has power but no energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Crisp means firm and brittle, like fresh lettuce.

clue.text: Stars careless, outwardly showy

indicators.note: outwardly means on the outside, so this word wraps around the other

parts.note: gay in its older sense means bright and showy
lax means careless or slack

explanation.surface: Celebrities who are sloppy but flashy on the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A galaxy is a vast system of stars; also a gathering of celebrities.

clue.text: Dispensing with singer, with wife having left

indicators.note: having left means gone, so these letters are removed

parts.note: the waxwing is a songbird, so a singer

explanation.surface: Firing a singer now that his wife has walked out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'singer' is a bird, the WAXWING.
explanation.definitionFit: Axing means cutting or getting rid of, dispensing with.

clue.text: Number two crossing line in game

indicators.note: crossing means running through, so this letter goes inside

parts.note: number two is a childish euphemism for poo

explanation.surface: The vice-captain crosses a line during a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number two' looks like a deputy; it is the nursery euphemism. 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Polo is a team game played on horseback.

clue.text: I catch retreating Trojan

indicators.note: retreating goes backwards, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: to nail someone is to catch them

explanation.surface: A soldier boasting of capturing a fleeing Trojan.
explanation.definitionFit: Ilian relates to Ilium, the Latin name for Troy, so it is another word for Trojan.

clue.text: Steer between smooth, bare borders in compound

indicators.note: between puts this piece in the middle, flanked by the others

parts.note: to iron is to smooth

indicators.note: to bare something strips its covering, so the outer letters go

parts.note: sides are the borders or edges of something
a steer is a castrated bull, an ox

explanation.surface: Directing a course between bare edges inside an enclosure, like a stockman with cattle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bare' strips SIDES of its outer letters to IDE; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Iron oxide, rust, is a chemical compound of iron and oxygen.

clue.text: Attach small volume penned by state puppet

parts.note: to pin is to attach

indicators.note: penned by means enclosed by, so this goes inside the other

parts.note: Ohio is a US state
cc is cubic centimetres, a small volume

explanation.surface: Instructions to fix a slim book written by a government official.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinocchio is the wooden puppet in Collodi's story.

clue.text: Number in view — not sure

indicators.note: not removes the following word's letters from the other piece

parts.note: eyesight is the faculty of viewing
yes and sure both express agreement

explanation.surface: Someone with a figure in view who is not certain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes YES from EYESIGHT; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Eight is a number, the integer after seven.
